description: Itemized price for a UniFi Wi-Fi, camera and door-access install at a given site address. Input the filled question set from get_unifi_questions. Returns equipment, labor, travel lines, totals and a quoteRef. Nothing is saved or sent. Use when the person wants a price for Wi-Fi, cameras or door access at a real address. (REST: POST /api/agent/v0/unifi_estimate)

answers.description: The filled question set template (site, infra, wifi, cameras, access, doors[], doorDefaults, gates[], ...)

name: unifi_estimate
title: UniFi estimate
